description: Use this when the user wants to be seen in person by a physical therapist, sports medicine clinic, chiropractor, sports massage therapist or recovery studio, in a city they name or near a position they share. It returns up to five Phorme clinic and recovery partners, nearest or best matching first, each with the kind of care, the services it lists, its page on phor.me and a link to ask for an appointment there. It takes a place and a kind of care, never symptoms. It reads only, does not diagnose or treat, shows no prices and books nothing.

care.description: The kind of care the user asked for, only if they named one.

city.description: The city the user named, for example "Austin".

near_lat.description: Latitude, only if the user shared their position.

near_lon.description: Longitude, only if the user shared their position.

name: find_clinic

clinics.description: Clinics, nearest or best matching first: name, care, line, city, country, distance_km, page_url, request_url and services.

limits.description: What this does not cover. Tell the user.

title: Find a Phorme clinic
